time.today: A moment earlier today, in lists of what happened. {time} is the time of day, already formatted for the language (15:25).
time.yesterday: A moment yesterday. {time} as in time.today.
time.dayAt: A moment on an earlier day. {day} is the day and month, already formatted for the language (Nov 20); {time} the time of day.
time.range: A span of days, as on a chart of weeks. {from} and {to} are days formatted as in time.dayAt.
deadline.over: A posting's application deadline has passed. Shown in a small badge next to the posting.
deadline.todayAt: The deadline is later today. {time} is when (23:59). Small badge.
deadline.tomorrow: The deadline is tomorrow (by the calendar, however few hours away). Small badge.
deadline.daysLeft: Days until the deadline, by the calendar; {n} is 2 or more. Plural forms separated by |, in the order of the language's plural categories (one | other for English). Small badge.
todos.deadline.past: On a to-do card about something with a deadline (an assessment, a reply): its deadline has passed.
todos.deadline.today: On a to-do card: its deadline is today.
todos.deadline.left: On a to-do card: days until its deadline; {n} is 1 or more. Plural forms as in deadline.daysLeft.
language.beta: In the language picker, next to a language whose translation is not complete yet. {name} is the language's own name.
analytics.change.same: Under a figure on the analytics page: it is the same as in the period of the same length before.
analytics.change.diff: Under a figure on the analytics page: how it changed against the period of the same length before. {change} is a signed percentage, already formatted (+20%, -15%).
todos.due.past: On a to-do card, after its due date (an interview, an assessment): the date has passed. Lower case: it follows the date after a dot (Nov 20 · overdue).
todos.due.today: On a to-do card, after its due date: it is today. Lower case, as todos.due.past.
calendar.nav: Sidebar entry of the calendar page.
calendar.title: Title of the calendar page.
calendar.sub: Line under the title of the calendar page.
calendar.add: Button: add an item of the applicant's own on a day.
calendar.addOn: Accessible name of the small + button under a day in the week view. {day} is a formatted date.
calendar.prev: Accessible name of the left-arrow button: the previous month, week or day.
calendar.next: Accessible name of the right-arrow button.
calendar.kind.deadline: Filter chip and item label: a posting's application deadline.
calendar.kind.assessment: Filter chip and item label: an online assessment or test to finish by a date.
calendar.kind.offer: Filter chip and item label: the date by which to answer an offer.
calendar.kind.info_request: Filter chip and item label: an employer asked for something to be sent by a date.
calendar.kind.contact: Filter chip and item label: a contact the applicant wanted to follow up with on that day.
calendar.kind.own: Filter chip and item label: an item the applicant added themselves.
calendar.kind.snoozed: Filter chip and item label: a to-do card put off until that time.
calendar.kind.sent: Filter chip and item label: an application went out at that time (to look back).
calendar.kind.reply: Filter chip and item label: an employer's mail arrived.
calendar.kind.task: Filter chip and item label: the program's own work waiting for its time.
calendar.state.label: Accessible name of the filter select.
calendar.state.any: First option of the state filter.
calendar.state.progressed: State filter option: assessment, interview or offer.
calendar.company: Placeholder of the company search box.
calendar.minScore: Filter label before a number (for deadlines).
calendar.allDeadlines: Filter checkbox: also deadlines of postings already applied for, set aside or offline.
calendar.deadlines: Badge in a month cell: how many posting deadlines fall on that day.
calendar.more: In a month cell, under the first three items.
calendar.allDay: In place of a time, for an item that has a day but no time.
calendar.timeline: Card title in the day view: the items with a time, in order.
calendar.nothingTimed: Empty state of the timeline card.
calendar.list: Card title in the day view: all items, most pressing first.
calendar.nothing: Empty state of the day list.
calendar.open: Button opening an item's link (the meeting of an interview, the start of an assessment).
calendar.linkAdd: Button: give the item a link (the meeting, the assessment).
calendar.start: Button on a deadline of a posting not applied for.
calendar.notApplying: Button on a deadline: mark the posting as one not applied for.
calendar.doneMsg: Short message after marking an item done.
calendar.movedMsg: Short message after changing an item's date.
calendar.started: Short message after Start an application.
calendar.added: Short message after adding an item.
calendar.form.title: Label of the text field of a new item.
calendar.form.titleHint: Example placeholder for a new item's text. Use a company name that is clearly made up.
calendar.form.link: Label: a link the item leads to (optional).
